purpose: Determine whether the misleadingly named BioASQ meshMajor field behaves like all assigned MeSH descriptors or only MajorTopicYN=Y headings in a deterministic sample spanning the measured 1946-2013 corpus.

evidence_seen_before_freeze.bounded_public_sample_result: The five public records contain 72 BioASQ assignments: 71 match maintained-current PubMed descriptors and 9 match maintained-current MajorTopicYN=Y headings.
evidence_seen_before_freeze.measured_source_result: The registered payload has 10,876,004 records spanning parseable years 1946-2013. The 280 records from 1946-1949 fall outside the prior protocol; all publication years are parseable.

revision_from_prior_protocol.reason: The prior protocol correctly rejects the measured payload because 280 records fall outside its frozen 1950-2013 strata.
changed: Add one 32-record SHA-256 bottom-k stratum covering all 280 measured records from 1946-1949.
Increase total sample size from 416 to 448.
Disclose the full-payload audit and the year-normalisation rule seen before this freeze.
unchanged: Hash namespace, hash input, record key, and tie breaker.
All eight prior strata, their sample sizes, and their rationales.
Maintained-current PubMed comparison rules and batch size.
All decision thresholds, labels, and zero-readiness rule.

strata.rationale: Covers the 280 measured records that contradict the reported post-1949 scope; 32 matches the allocation for each other broad historical stratum without treating this small anomalous group as population-representative.
Older records are most exposed to maintained-current indexing drift.
Covers the era of the canonical Swanson development diagnostics without treating it as period-appropriate.
Separates late twentieth-century records from the post-2002 candidate window.
Contains the frozen 2006 publication cutoff used by one proposed post-2002 positive case.
Contains the frozen 2010 publication cutoff used by one proposed post-2002 positive case.
Directly audits the source-defined 2011 cutoff used by two proposed post-2002 positive cases.

limitations: The strata are deliberately balanced around source anomalies and scientific cutoffs and are not weighted to estimate a corpus-wide population fraction.
PubMed EFetch exposes maintained-current records, not the MeSH assignments or major-topic flags frozen on 1 March 2013.
A passing result is bounded evidence about field semantics in 448 predeclared records; it is not proof of PMID-level corpus completeness or an original historical-baseline substitute.
Sampling 32 of the 280 pre-1950 records measures their field semantics but does not repair or explain the mismatch with the reported post-1949 corpus scope.
This protocol cannot contribute metric-v3 readiness and no gap score, rank, bridge, or candidate formula may enter sampling or interpretation.
